migrations.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patient_profile (
  patient_id           TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES patients(id),
  preferred_language   TEXT,
  medication_awareness TEXT,
  diagnosis            TEXT,
  updated_at           INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patient_circle_member (
  id            TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  patient_id    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES patients(id),
  kind          TEXT NOT NULL,
  display_name  TEXT NOT NULL,
  relationship  TEXT,
  phone         TEXT,
  email         TEXT,
  is_primary_nr INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_circle_patient ON patient_circle_member(patient_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patient_consent_state (
  patient_id                       TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES patients(id),
  advance_directive_status         TEXT,
  advance_directive_document_id    TEXT,
  informed_consent_status          TEXT,
  tele_consent_mode                TEXT,
  capacity_status                  TEXT,
  confidentiality_exception_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  updated_at                       INTEGER NOT NULL
);

queryTemplates.sql:
SELECT id, created_at, updated_at, given_name, family_name,
       contact_phone, contact_email, dob, status
FROM patients WHERE id = @id

SELECT p.id, p.given_name, p.family_name, p.status,
       COALESCE(pl.stage, 'active') AS stage
FROM patients p
LEFT JOIN patient_lifecycle pl ON pl.patient_id = p.id
ORDER BY p.family_name ASC, p.given_name ASC

SELECT patient_id, preferred_language, medication_awareness, diagnosis, updated_at
FROM patient_profile WHERE patient_id = @id

SELECT patient_id, stage, stage_updated_at, stage_reason
FROM patient_lifecycle WHERE patient_id = @id

SELECT id, patient_id, kind, display_name, relationship, phone, email, is_primary_nr
FROM patient_circle_member WHERE patient_id = @id
ORDER BY is_primary_nr DESC, display_name ASC

SELECT id, patient_id, kind, display_name, relationship, phone, email, is_primary_nr
FROM patient_circle_member WHERE id = @id

SELECT patient_id, advance_directive_status, advance_directive_document_id,
       informed_consent_status, tele_consent_mode, capacity_status,
       confidentiality_exception_active, updated_at
FROM patient_consent_state WHERE patient_id = @id
